responsibility: Declares the generated pass-2 parser entry point. Its `CompilationUnit` routine drives the detailed declaration-building pass that fills in types, parameters, constants, and structural metadata needed before aggregate constant resolution and quad generation.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface file for the pass-2 parser, exporting only CompilationUnit; unlike P2Build.bnf, it does not contain the parser grammar or semantic actions.
